messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary deploy 'model-v2' (us-west-2) shows a sustained error-rate spike and SLO burn. Paging @maria on-call. Alert: canary.error_rate > 2% over 5m; affected stacks: inference-proxy, runtime-gpu.

maria: on it. where's the dashboard? I can't find canary p95 panel in the deploy dashboard — only overall prod.

aj: I think we removed the per-canary dashboard tile in the rollout PR earlier today (sorry). I reverted most alert routing but left the canary-specific panels out to reduce noise. this is on me.

sam: fyi support started getting customer tickets ~10:14 UTC, small number of 502s. support-bot forwarded a sample trace to #support.

lina: we have noisy infra alerts (cpu > 85%) that are firing separately per host and creating SLO noise. looks like alert grouping got broken when we changed alertlabels in the alertmanager config during infra deploy.

maria: quick assessment — can we kill the feature flag for the canary (immediate rollback) while we triage dashboards/alerts?

aj: yes, we can flip the flag. using the flag service:

```
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/model-v2-canary/actions -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"action":"disable","who":"maria"}'
```

aj: done. flag toggled at 10:19 UTC. starting traffic shift back to model-v1. monitor for error_rate to drop.

maria: confirming: error_rate down to ~0.4% in last minute window, latency back to baseline, but SLO burn alert still active because alerts aggregate by label that changed.

dana: support says one enterprise customer (acme-corp) saw ~30 failed requests during the ~5 minute window. ops notified customer success.

product-ops: thanks, sending a brief incident note to the account team. can we get a short RCA bullet for them? cause, mitigation, customer impact, next steps.

sam: immediate mitigation = flag kill + rollback; impact = transient 502s ~0.2% of global requests, one enterprise reported errors but no data loss; timeline attached in support thread.

maria: longer term: re-add per-canary dashboard tiles, fix alert label grouping in alertmanager, make canary-specific synthetic checks and a separate SLO bucket for canaries. also add an automatic guard to prevent removing dashboard panels during rollouts.

aj: opened infra ticket INF-412: restore alert label grouping and add dedupe. opened rollout ticket RL-97: enforce dashboard presence in release checklist.

lina: logs show the alertmanager label change happened at 10:06 UTC during an infra deploy; we should correlate with CI unlocks. I'll add a note to INF-412 with diff.

maria: handing ongoing follow-ups to sam for postmortem and to aj for infra fixes. sam, can you own the postmortem and timeline? I'll stay as incident lead until it's wrapped.

sam: yep, will own the postmortem. will include timeframe, affected customers, why dashboards were removed, and mitigation steps. ETA draft in 2 hours.

support-bot: ticket #19422 created for acme-corp, CS alerted.

maria: current status: rollback complete, error_rate recovered, SLO alert still needs manual clear after label fix. action items: AJ -> INF-412, SAM -> PM-125 postmortem, LINA -> investigate alertmanager change, PRODUCT-OPS -> customer comms. closing page, will reopen if we see reoccurrence. :white_check_mark:
__notes: Slack thread: observability gap discovered during a canary deploy; contains incident bot, handoff, kill-switch, and customer impact assessment. Messages are in chronological order and use short, informal Slack style.
